highlights: Pro and Pro+ cost about a third of what they did. Pro is $1.99 a month or $14.99 a year, and Pro+ is $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year, in US dollars; the App Store shows your local price. If you already subscribe, your plan renews at the lower price.
Moving from monthly to yearly, or from Pro to Pro+, now takes effect straight away instead of at your next renewal.
